features.statement: Page uses a styled sans-serif font stack throughout rather than browser-default serif
Hero headline is very large (about 64px), light weight, white text, as the page's single h1
Section headings are h2 elements at large light-weight sizes, giving a proper h1→h2 hierarchy
Navigation and link groups are marked up as ul/li lists
Header includes a small rounded 'Menu' button element for mobile navigation, hidden at desktop width
Page title combines brand name with descriptive tagline separated by an em dash
White page background with dark navy body text instead of transparent background and black text
Large full-bleed hero or team photograph with descriptive, sentence-style alt text
Icons are normalized to a uniform small square size and placed inside cards
Content sits in a centered, max-width container with generous side margins instead of default body margin
Palette is dark navy, light gray section backgrounds and a single cyan accent color
Small uppercase, letter-spaced cyan eyebrow labels appear above section headings
Announcement appears as a dark full-width strip with centered text and a cyan arrow
News is a ruled list with date, title and uppercase cyan 'READ MORE' link in separate columns
Footer is a dark navy band with logo, uppercase nav, divider rule and copyright/legal row split left and right
Navigation links are uppercase, letter-spaced, right-aligned opposite a left-aligned logo
Sticky header uses semi-transparent dark background with backdrop blur
Small border radii (a few pixels) on cards and buttons give softly rounded corners
Interactive elements define CSS transitions for hover effects
Body text uses a comfortable fixed line height of about 1.6
Generous section spacing makes the page long and airy
Copy is polished with terminal periods on subtitles and short taglines under section headings
Feature pillars are shown as a 2x2 grid of dark boxed cards beside a left-column heading
Links are light or white uppercase text without underline; only inline card links are underlined in accent color
Section uses two-column split with heading and outlined 'READ MORE' button on left and cards on right
Lean markup: single inline style block, one script, no external stylesheets, no inline style attributes, few classes
